fields.summary: The shipit work plan for task 4: a pure internal/model package that projects folded change sets into three views, as-is (landed), to-be (as-is plus accepted) and what-if (as-is plus one change set), orders change sets causally, detects conflicts and never fails. Decided (D1-D13, agent wording accepted by the owner): scope is the pure package only, no CLI, index, rebase or field-level diff; AsIs, ToBe and WhatIf return a Model and problems; causal order comes from base edges and existence edges, ties by change set ID, with cycles reported and broken at the smallest ID; a conflict is a stale base that overlaps an earlier write (same field or handle, a move against a move, anything against a retire), while non-overlapping stale operations merge silently; a conflicting operation still applies, later wins, and is reported; operations that break model rules are skipped and reported; to-be and what-if use the same engine and rules; Overlaps reports field-level overlapping pairs among in-flight change sets; duplicate handles are reported, not skipped; nodes and links carry their history, version and creating change set; tests are TDD with rapid determinism and commutativity properties and the corpus projected in every view; guardrails keep other packages' APIs unchanged. Settled later in review (D14): a landed conflict counts as repaired once later operations written from the current version rewrite every aspect the conflicting operation wrote, and a conflict involving a retirement stays reported. Endpoint kinds were left to task 9's check.
fields.title: Shipit plan, milestone 1 task 4: projection
